# Errorgram

> An open inventory of Telegram Bot API errors, with stable IDs and bindings
> for Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, aiogram, and grammY.

Use the JSON catalogue for matching rules and Markdown for explanations.
IDs describe observable conditions; they do not prove one underlying cause.
Transport failures and framework validation are outside this inventory.
Enrichment is opt-in. Errorgram does not retry, suppress errors, or change bot state.

Telegram Bot API error responses. Source-derived; hosted deployment behavior is unverified.
Synthetic examples derived from the cited source.

Catalogue 0.1.0 · schema 1.0.0 · reviewed 2026-09-15.

## Error conditions

- [auth.invalid\_token\_format](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/auth.invalid_token_format/): The server rejected the token during local validation. ([Markdown](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/auth.invalid_token_format.md); [JSON](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/auth.invalid_token_format.json))
- [bot.blocked\_by\_user](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/bot.blocked_by_user/): The user has blocked the bot. ([Markdown](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/bot.blocked_by_user.md); [JSON](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/bot.blocked_by_user.json))
- [chat.migrated](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/chat.migrated/): The group has moved to a supergroup with a new ID. ([Markdown](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/chat.migrated.md); [JSON](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/chat.migrated.json))
- [chat.not\_found](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/chat.not_found/): The bot could not resolve this chat. ([Markdown](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/chat.not_found.md); [JSON](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/chat.not_found.json))
- [file.download\_too\_large](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/file.download_too_large/): The file exceeds the server’s non-local download limit. ([Markdown](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/file.download_too_large.md); [JSON](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/file.download_too_large.json))
- [message.delete\_forbidden](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/message.delete_forbidden/): Telegram rejected deletion of the message. ([Markdown](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/message.delete_forbidden.md); [JSON](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/message.delete_forbidden.json))
- [message.not\_modified](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/message.not_modified/): The requested message content and reply markup are unchanged. ([Markdown](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/message.not_modified.md); [JSON](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/message.not_modified.json))
- [query.invalid\_or\_expired](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/query.invalid_or_expired/): The query ID is invalid or its response window has expired. ([Markdown](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/query.invalid_or_expired.md); [JSON](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/query.invalid_or_expired.json))
- [request.retry\_after](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/request.retry_after/): The server asks the bot to wait before trying again. ([Markdown](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/request.retry_after.md); [JSON](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/request.retry_after.json))
- [routing.token\_not\_served](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/routing.token_not_served/): The token failed the server’s bot-ID or routing check. ([Markdown](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/routing.token_not_served.md); [JSON](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/routing.token_not_served.json))
- [server.restarting](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/server.restarting/): The bot client is closing for a server restart. ([Markdown](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/server.restarting.md); [JSON](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/server.restarting.json))
- [session.logged\_out](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/session.logged_out/): The bot session has logged out. ([Markdown](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/session.logged_out.md); [JSON](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/session.logged_out.json))
- [updates.concurrent\_poll](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/updates.concurrent_poll/): Another getUpdates request interrupted the pending long poll. ([Markdown](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/updates.concurrent_poll.md); [JSON](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/updates.concurrent_poll.json))
- [updates.webhook\_active](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/updates.webhook_active/): Polling was requested while a webhook is active or being configured. ([Markdown](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/updates.webhook_active.md); [JSON](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/updates.webhook_active.json))
- [webhook.certificate\_too\_large](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/webhook.certificate_too_large/): The uploaded webhook certificate exceeds the server’s size limit. ([Markdown](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/webhook.certificate_too_large.md); [JSON](https://errorgram.rmbk.me/errors/webhook.certificate_too_large.json))
